quest.title: In Expert Company? (II)
quest.description: Ms. Qiu's group seems to be in trouble again...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Poisson Seafood Soup x1

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: No problem. Our box is waterproof. All we need to do is dive down and fetch it...

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: Boss, none of us here knows how to dive.

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: I know how to swim, but diving's beyond me.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: Is... is the commission we posted at the Adventurers' Guild still on the board?

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: Boss, didn't you say before that we should hurry up and take the commission down?

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: We did that yesterday. The guild said they can return us our prepaid commission posting fee today.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: Uh... If we want to send out a commission again, are we going to need to pay an additional service fee...

choices.text: Have you guys finished your film?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #Adventurer... {NICKNAME}! You came right when we needed you!

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Can you dive? Or... can you help me find a diver with the ability and time to do a dive?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You want to... do an underwater shoot?

response.speaker: Yifeng
response.text: We're hardly that capable. We also can't afford water-proof film equipment.

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: It's purely because the box we put our films in fell into the water.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #Alright, that's enough you two! {NICKNAME}, you gotta help us.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Don't worry about the payment. I'll pay you upfront, just like last time.

choices.text: What are you guys doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #Aha! You're the best, {NICKNAME}. You're the absolute best!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: If it weren't for you, everything inside the case would have been lost.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: We need to get back to the city and give these films to Mr. Geisert.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #And then... let's have a meal together. {NICKNAME}, if you're interested, you can come too.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: After we finish eating, I'll pay you your reward.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Alright! It's settled.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Yifeng, bring the films in this box over to Mr. Geisert later.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Xingye, go get some good greens from nearby. I've been practicing my Poisson Seafood Soup, and it's time to show it off to Mr. Geisert.

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: Boss, we're already going to the restaurant. Why do you still get to do things yourself?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: So that we can save costs...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Ahem! It's settled. Let's get going.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you can follow me.

choices.text: Well, I just happen to be hungry.

talks.objective: Report back to Ms. Qiu and her company

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: This pot is pretty strange. Hmm... but it should be used the same way as the ones in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: Boss, I got the veggies, but they're all out of Marcotte.

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: I couldn't find any other store that sells it...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #That's... the last ingredient we needed. Well, uh, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Thanks for your help. Don't worry, I know how adventurers work. This isn't a free favor.

talks.objective: Give the Marcotte to Ms. Qiu

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'd like to introduce you to a master filmmaker, Mr. Geisert.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #Mr. Geisert, this is {NICKNAME}, a highly skilled adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #If you plan to shoot an action film in the future, you should definitely consider casting {NICKNAME} as the lead!

dialogues.speaker: Geisert
dialogues.text: Haha, Ms. Qiu exaggerates. I'm not some filmmaking expert.

dialogues.speaker: Geisert
dialogues.text: I'm just someone who's somewhat familiar with the uses of lighting for filmmaking.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're too modest. The lighting in your films practically speaks for itself.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: Yeah. In my lighting theory, I believe that the manipulation of lighting is the manipulation of emotion.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: But... how should I put this... My theories have yet to be regarded in Fontaine's film industry.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: Most directors prefer to use direct movement or the scene itself to illustrate their stories.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: I've shot a few films purely using lighting transitions to express narrative, but almost no one was interested.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: But now, at least one director thinks my lighting theory has value.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Director? Me? Hahaha, don't jest. I was just a tea vendor.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: Who said a tea vendor can't be a director? I was just a journalist before.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: A journalist... Then you must be good at writing reports? Just like those in the papers.

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: I suppose. What about it?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Huh... Just as well...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Ah! Nothing, nothing. Let's eat! We will have plenty of time to work together in the future, hahaha!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone takes a seat to Ms. Qiu's forthright laughter.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After the meal, Ms. Qiu makes an additional meal and stuffs it in your bag after packaging it...

choices.text: Is lighting very important in filmmaking?

response.speaker: Geisert
response.text: Of course. In my theories, lighting is the key way mood is expressed in a scene.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: Okay, gotta get this meal started as soon as possible. Gotta do this fast. Mr. Geisert is almost here...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I hope the films won't be damaged by the water.

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: Don't worry Boss, the box is sealed tight. The water won't be getting in.

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: Good thing our Film Kamera didn't fall in. Otherwise, it would be a total flop...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, did you get the Marcotte?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got it.
